sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. A chest-up portrait against a continuous muted gray-olive painted background, darker at the upper corners and lighter behind the lower face and shoulders; retain the entire background and all four rectangular edges, with no card frame, paper note or exterior cutout. The head is near frontal with a slight turn toward screen right and a gentle smiling red mouth with a small pale tooth line. A light silver-gray draped headscarf covers the crown, sides of the head and neck, with layered shiny folds crossing over the upper chest; no exposed hairstyle is established beneath this covering. Thin dark curved brows and round dark-rimmed spectacles with slender warm-metal temples and pale lens reflections are visible. There is no visible moustache or chin beard. The teal-green coat has broad pointed lapels and a prominent large dark circular button low in the crop. Keep the scarf over the coat collar, the recognizable coat opening, shoulder crop, soft upper-left face/scarf highlights and lower shadow. Exact tiny lens reflections are limited by the 156x210 source pixels and should not be turned into extra facial features. Actual source alpha extrema are252..255: the painted rectangle has no visibly transparent outer silhouette or missing interior backing.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A chest-up near-frontal portrait with a slight turn toward screen right, a gentle red-lipped smile, dark curved brows and no visible eyewear or facial hair. Short swept-back light-brown hair has broad rolled waves and pale gray-blond highlights over the forehead and sides; preserve this visible shape rather than inventing covered or long hair. A deep burgundy scarf wraps around the neck and drapes onto the chest, showing several irregular pale ochre-gold oval and leaf-like shapes; beneath it is a plain dark plum-brown top. No hat, uniform insignia or medals are visible. Retain the scarf overlap and opening, shoulder and upper-chest crop, the light from upper left across the forehead and hair, and the muted gray-olive painted background with a dark upper vignette. There is no separate photo frame, backing card, note or transparent exterior cutout: preserve the continuous complete rectangular painting. The precise tiny scarf-pattern contours are not reliably resolved at156x210, although the scarf color and large contrasting mark groups are clear. Actual source alpha extrema are252..255; do not remove the original painted backing.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A chest-up portrait, near frontal with a slight turn toward screen right and a small red-lipped smile showing a pale tooth line. Medium chestnut-brown hair is side-parted, swept back from the forehead and falls in distinct full waves and curled ends onto both shoulders; dark curved brows are visible. A pair of silver-framed dark-lensed aviator-shaped sunglasses rests on top of the hair above the forehead, not over the eyes. No moustache or chin beard is visible. The dark blue-gray garment has horizontal darker stripes and a broad folded overlapping collar forming an open V at the throat; retain the V opening, collar overlap and shoulder crop. Keep the soft upper-left highlights on the forehead and curls, the subdued gray-olive background and darker upper corners. This is the complete rectangular painted canvas, without a photo/card frame, paper note, medals or exterior-only cutout; all original background remains. Tiny sunglass hinges and fine fabric linework exceed the reliable source detail, but the glasses placement and large stripe/collar structures are clear. Actual source alpha extrema are252..255 with no visible missing background.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A chest-up portrait with head and gaze angled slightly toward screen left, a serious closed mouth and a narrow dark moustache directly above the upper lip; the chin is clean, without a beard or goatee. Thick dark brown hair rises into a high swept-back wavy pompadour with gray highlights and shorter gray-brown side hair. Distinct dark arched brows and round dark spectacles with slender warm-metal temples and strong pale lens reflections are visible; keep the eyes behind those spectacles. A brown civilian suit jacket with broad notched lapels and a small lapel slit on screen right is worn over an ivory pointed-collar shirt and a necktie with diagonal burgundy-red and muted ochre-brown bands. Preserve the tied neckwear, collar contacts, broad shoulders and mid-chest crop, with highlights across the upper-left hair/forehead and light shirt. No hat or medals are present. The continuous muted gray-olive painted background fills the entire rectangle, darker above and lighter behind the shoulders, without any photo frame, card, note or transparent outer silhouette. Fine details of the tiny lapel slit and lens reflections are limited by156x210 source pixels; the visible moustache and eyewear are clear. Actual source alpha extrema are252..255; retain the painted backing intact.
